title: A Hymn for the Smile
author: Cyrus Joubert
blurb: Hazel Eriksen, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. But when all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
